title: When the Extraction Sings
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Marguerite Whitlock, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
